A2 Milk's core metrics to watch include revenue trajectory in China infant formula (key channel mix between daigou, cross-border e-commerce, and domestic label), gross margin progression amid competitive pricing pressure, and net cash position which has historically supported buyback capacity.

Investors should monitor any FY26 guidance language closely — particularly around China label registration momentum, US market investment burn rate, and whether management reaffirms or revises its medium-term EBITDA margin targets, as these will be the primary near-term share price catalysts post-release.
